summary: A plugin that gives Hermes Agent long-term memory backed by a Neo4j property graph. It connects the neo4j-agent-memory library to Hermes as a memory provider, so entities, preferences and facts persist across sessions and can be found again with semantic search using vector similarity. It adds five memory tools, works with the LLM and embedding providers that neo4j-agent-memory supports, includes a setup wizard, and if Neo4j cannot be reached it marks itself unavailable so Hermes carries on without memory instead of crashing. Open source under the Apache 2.0 license.
